summary: Implemented the complete M0 skeleton: typed API health/provider/module/audit contracts and tests, minimal typed web skeleton, deterministic development Compose topology, Make commands, developer documentation, and the CI test lane. All host-executable validation passed. Python test/lint, TypeScript typecheck, and Git commit are blocked by the sandbox execution environment.

tests.name: Python unit tests
tests.evidence: pytest and all API runtime dependencies are absent locally; pip install cannot resolve pypi.org because DNS/network access is unavailable. Exit 1: /usr/bin/python3: No module named pytest.

tests.name: API lint
tests.evidence: ruff is not installed and cannot be installed through the blocked network. Source compilation was run instead and passed.

tests.name: Web typecheck
tests.evidence: No Node.js/npm/npx runtime exists on the host. A host TypeScript binary exists but cannot execute without Node; package installation is blocked by DNS/network access.

security_rights_budget_impact: No secrets, external side effects, rights actions, publishing paths, or spend are introduced. Development credentials are explicitly marked local-only. Provider identity remains registry-resolved and the no-hardcoded-identifier test is present. Audit output is structured JSON lines in an ignored .agent/audit directory.
known_limitations: Automated Python and TypeScript quality gates must execute in CI or an environment with package and Node runtime access.
Docker Compose configuration is valid, but container startup was not attempted because the current user cannot access the Docker socket.
Git commit is unavailable because the shared Git directory is read-only from this worktree.
The package intentionally contains no product feature code or database migrations.
blockers: Package installs required for pytest, ruff, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and HTTPX fail because DNS/network access is unavailable; pip reports 'Name or service not known' for pypi.org.
Node.js/npm/npx are absent, so npx tsc --noEmit cannot run locally.

Git index creation fails with 'Read-only file system' at /srv/clipos/clipOS/.git/worktrees/CLIP-001/index.lock; the tree state is preserved in .agent/dryrun/CLIP-001_tree_state.txt for orchestrator landing.
